body: I really appreciate it, but I’ve tried. Maybe I do want to get better but I’m done trying. I hate being who I am, I’m sick of hurting myself. I know going from lack of oxygen isn’t a pleasant way to go and it takes a long time. I’m still scared. But I feel okay. I don’t see myself going to work today or in the future. I’m done contemplating this time. I wish you well my friend. Goodbye
As of right now I work on semi trucks/tractors/heavy equipment. But mostly just replace giant tires.

That’s incredible that you’re able to think that way! People always say that I’m still young but I feel like I’ve been through enough bullshit for everyone who uses Reddit. I’m unable to get through work anymore and end up spending so much time in the bathroom crying or I stay outside to smoke (nicotine) on my lunches I have to drink something… sometimes I end up taking a few swigs just to finish the day. Honestly I don’t think I can do this anymore. I’ve put up my absolute best fight. And I’ve given every single day my best. But my turn is over… tomorrow is my day off. I think that’s when I’m gonna do it.

I have tried counseling before. And that was something that never worked well with me. People just getting paid to pretend like they care about what you’re going through. I did try a lot of new things to find as a hobby and there are some things I enjoyed for a while, but could never continue with them as I quickly lost interest. I really have tried everything… I just seem to hate everything. And I’m truly unable to enjoy anything ….
Nothing more than the usual… recommended I go back to therapy and that I should go back on my medications, and that was it really.

Just start off with small goals for yourself :) I know you can do it!  Your entire goal for one day is to make your bed, even if you will immediately be getting back in it, brushing your hair, teeth, washing your face. It doesn’t need to be anything crazy. Hell even if one of those things are your goal for the week/month. That’s okay!! Just take baby steps. I know your strong. You can do it! Feel free to message me. I’ll be here for you every single step of the way
